note: 各館雕像與石碑的科學家簡介。學生看得到的文字，不寫課本頁碼與章節編號。

zh.name: 牛頓
zh.text: 他提出萬有引力和三大運動定律，用同一套規則解釋地上落下的物體，和繞著地球轉的月亮。

en.name: Isaac Newton
en.text: He proposed universal gravitation and the three laws of motion — one set of rules for objects falling on Earth and for the Moon circling it.

zh.name: 拉瓦節
zh.text: 他用精密的天平證明：物質燃燒是和氧結合，而且反應前後的總質量不變。因此被稱為「現代化學之父」。

en.name: Antoine Lavoisier
en.text: With a precise balance he showed that burning is combining with oxygen, and that total mass stays the same before and after a reaction. He is called the father of modern chemistry.

zh.name: 韋格納
zh.role: 德國氣象學家、地球物理學家
zh.text: 他提出「大陸漂移說」：今天的大陸原本連成一塊，後來慢慢分開。這個想法後來發展成板塊構造學說。

en.name: Alfred Wegener
en.text: He proposed continental drift: today's continents were once joined and slowly moved apart. The idea later grew into the theory of plate tectonics.

zh.name: 達爾文
zh.text: 他搭乘小獵犬號環遊世界，觀察加拉巴哥群島等地的生物，提出以天擇為核心的演化論。

en.name: Charles Darwin
en.text: Sailing around the world on HMS Beagle, he studied life in places like the Galápagos and proposed the theory of evolution by natural selection.
